title: Cursor Academy Corpus Index Manifest
description: Represents the metadata and integrity manifest of the persistent retrieval layer (RAG-over-corpus) in ARS v4.0.

chunker_version.description: The version of the text chunker used, e.g., 'recursive-v1'.

embedding_model.description: Identifier of the embedding model, e.g., 'text-embedding-3-small' or 'cohere-embed-english-v3.0'.

embedding_dimension.description: Dimensionality of the vector space, e.g., 1536.

chunk_count.description: Total number of chunks in the corpus index.

indexed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the index was last built or updated.

content_hash_map.description: Mapping from content hash of the literature item (source_pointer / file hash) to chunk-id range or status.
